input.incident_description: A service cannot write new log entries and begins failing requests.
input.logs: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device
input.expected_behavior: The service should write logs and process requests.

probable_causes: The filesystem or inode allocation used by the service is exhausted.
evidence: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device

recommended_steps.purpose: Check filesystem capacity and inode usage without modifying data.
Identify large directories under /var while remaining on the same filesystem.

verification_steps: Free space using an approved retention or cleanup procedure.
Confirm adequate disk and inode headroom.
Restart or retry the affected service and monitor logs.
missing_information: The affected mount point and current capacity were not provided.

input.incident_description: Requests time out and Gunicorn repeatedly replaces workers.
input.logs:
[CRITICAL] WORKER TIMEOUT (pid: 2418)
[WARNING] Worker with pid 2418 was terminated due to signal 9
input.expected_behavior: Requests should complete within the configured timeout.

probable_causes: A request exceeds the Gunicorn worker timeout.
The new report endpoint may perform blocking or resource-intensive work.
evidence: Worker with pid 2418 was terminated due to signal 9

recommended_steps.purpose: Correlate worker timeouts with request and application errors.
Profile the report endpoint and move long-running work out of the request path before increasing timeouts.

verification_steps: Reproduce the report request in a controlled environment.
Confirm request duration stays below the configured timeout.
missing_information: The configured timeout and request duration were not provided.
